items.t: Quiet aftermath. Nobody is speaking, the crisis has passed, low energy affection.
Slow motion disaster. Something is going wrong and exactly one person has noticed.
A private joke. Mid laugh, at each other, not at the viewer.

alt.1: A private joke that nobody else would get. Mid laugh, and never at the viewer.

items.t: Overstimulation. Too much noise and light, one person retreating, another quietly shielding them.
Smug competence. Somebody has solved it and is being unbearable about it.
Companionable boredom. Nothing is happening and that is fine.
